NASA_wing_coordinate_basis: Aircraft FS/WBL/WL in inches; section ordinates dimensionless
UPC_frame_basis: Existing raster nose-relative/candidate E anchor; correspondence to absolute aircraft FS is not verified.
finding: A numerical FS/BL-backed pivot is not sufficient to place it in a nose-relative UPC fuselage frame. The longitudinal translation, as well as vertical datum, needs independent correspondence.
implication: Crank containment failure cannot be resolved by changing glove shape or mechanism position solely in the current mixed candidate frame.
required_next: Recover nose FS or at least two matching original longitudinal landmarks with source uncertainty; estimate scale/translation and verify an independent third landmark.
